description: Use this when a user wants a sudoku to play or print, or an app needs a verified puzzle at a named difficulty. Generates ONE sudoku puzzle with a unique solution, 180-degree symmetry, graded by the solving techniques it needs (easy | medium | hard | expert). Returns 81-char puzzle and solution strings (row by row, 0 = empty), given count and technique list. Deterministic when a seed is supplied. 20 per minute shared by all clients.

level.description: Difficulty by solving technique: easy, medium, hard or expert.
level.title: Level

seed.description: Integer 1-2147483647 for a reproducible puzzle; omit for a random one.
seed.title: Seed

name: sudoku_puzzle
title: Generate one solver-verified sudoku
